text: Team update: Dr. Miriam Okafor has now spent 14 years in practice, and our Southeast Portland team keeps growing. Thank you to every patient who sent a friend our way this year. #PortlandDentistry
Back-to-school reminder 🦷 A check-up and cleaning is $145 at our office, and it's a good time to get the whole family seen before the fall schedule fills up. Call (503) 555-0142 to book.
Thinking about whitening? Our in-office session is $350. Results vary from person to person, so we'll talk through what to expect at your visit first. #PortlandDental #SEPortland
Our Friday hours run 8am to 2pm, and we're closed on Saturday and Sunday so our team can recharge. Need to be seen? Call during office hours at (503) 555-0142.
Our favorite kind of phone call: a patient who finally books the visit they've been putting off. If that's you, our front desk will walk you through the options at (503) 555-0142. #DentalCare
First batch of the morning is out 🥐 Butter croissants, pain au chocolat and cinnamon buns that smell like a hug. Pop in before 9 for the best of the tray. #CamberwellEats #LondonBakery
Friday treat alert! 10% off for orders over £30 on Fridays. Ordering for the office or a birthday? Call us on +44 20 7946 0183 or pop in to Lansdowne Parade 🍞
Our sourdough loaf is £4.50 and every one is proved for 24 hours. Slow bread, happy faces 😊 Grab one on your way home. #Sourdough #SouthLondon
Seventeen years of baking on site every morning since 2009. Thank you to everyone who has queued at our door, especially the early birds. Here's to the next seventeen 🙌

Sunday hours are 8:30am to 1pm, so come for a lazy brunch and leave with a slice of lemon drizzle cake. Golden-brown is our favourite colour, and this cake is the proof 🍋 Saturdays we're open 8am to 5pm too.
Mondays feeling a bit stiff? 🌊 Roll out your mat for our 6am flow. Good vibes, zero judgement, no headstands required. #SurryHillsYoga #BlueWaveYoga
New to yoga? Try a casual class for $25, or grab the 10-class pass for $220 and treat yourself to a proper stretch. Call (02) 9555 0148 to sort out your first class 🧘

Small classes, big calm. We cap every class at 12 people, so your teacher can actually see your downward dog 🐶 Our favourite time of the week? Sunday morning, 8am to 11am, when the studio is at its calmest.
Desk-job shoulders giving you grief? Our classes are small enough that every teacher sees where you're tight. Drop in any weekday from 6am to 8pm. Your neck might thank you 🌊
Weekend reset: Saturday and Sunday, 8am to 11am, mat down, feet up. Every week someone says 'I'll just try one' and comes back for the next. You're next, mate 🌊 Colour us excited!

Tax season is calmer when receipts are sorted month by month. We help sole traders and small firms in Toronto keep their books up to date, so there's less to chase at year end. Call (416) 555-0167 to talk it through.

Freelancers, we see you 👋 Chasing invoices and receipts takes time you'd rather spend with clients. Our monthly bookkeeping starts from CAD 350 a month. Call (416) 555-0167 to find out what's included.
Our Toronto office is open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, by appointment. Personal tax returns start from CAD 180, and we'll confirm the fee before we begin ☕ #TorontoAccountant #SmallBusinessCanada

Proud to be a family-run practice since 2011. Thank you to our clients across the GTA for trusting us with your numbers. Next up: a quick year-end checklist for clients, because a little organizing goes a long way 🍁
Quick reminder: our office hours are Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, by appointment. Call (416) 555-0167 and we'll get your paperwork in order. Keep your receipts organized, eh? 🍁

Tuesday night, a glass of something red, zero plans 🍷 Wines by the glass from S$18 at Cellar Door. Drink responsibly, we're here for good company, not the bottle. #CellarDoorSG #TanjongPagarEats
First Thursday of the month is our tasting night at 7pm 🥂 Our tasting flight is S$42, so bring a friend and share the glasses. Please drink responsibly, and get a ride home if you're driving.
Team drinks sorted? Our wine list rotates across 30 wines, so there's always something new to talk about after work. We're open Tuesday to Saturday, 4pm to midnight. Please drink responsibly.
Hot take: the best wine is the one a friend picked for you 🍾 Ours are poured by the glass from S$18, so bring your friend and let them choose. Drink responsibly, folks.
We're shut Sunday and Monday to give the cellar a breather 🕓 Tuesday to Saturday, 4pm to midnight, so come raise a glass, not a ruckus. Drink responsibly, and call +65 6225 0148 with any questions.
Flat tyre on a Monday morning? Puncture repairs are R120 at our Woodstock workshop 🛞 Call +27 21 555 0136 and we'll tell you when to drop it in. Guess we're your spoke-person! 🚲

Full service from R890 🔧 Gears, brakes and a proper clean. Or just need a check? Our basic service is R450. Workshop is open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm and Saturday 8am to 1pm. Chain reaction? We're the link you can trust 🔗
Your bike doesn't have to ride to us 🚚 Free pickup and drop-off within 5km on orders over R800. Wheel you be needing us again? Probably 😉 #CapeTownCycling
Commuter tip from the Woodstock workshop: check your tyre pressure before the week gets going. A basic service is R450 and we'll talk you through what you need. Stay in gear, Cape Town.
Weekend ride coming up? Call +27 21 555 0136 and we'll find you a slot. We're open until 1pm on Saturdays, so don't leave it too late. Rim-ly good service, every time 🛞
